attempts.summary: Built a site-to-site IPsec tunnel between node1 (OPNsense, in front of node3/lan-a) and node2 (OPNsense, in front of node4/lan-b) over their shared transit network. node3 and node4 now reach each other by private address (10.50.10.12 <-> 10.50.20.13) with all inter-site traffic encrypted (IKEv2/ESP). Completed the mandatory sequential restart-and-recovery protocol on all four nodes, confirming persistence of the tunnel and routing across reboots.
